name: media-ffmpeg
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Local ffmpeg wrapper. Audio chopping, format conversion, basic filters. No LLM — just calls the ffmpeg binary on the host.

input.description: Absolute path to the input media file

output.description: Absolute path for the output file (default: <VORTEX_HOME>/deliverables/<project>/ffmpeg_<ts>.<ext>)

file.description: Absolute path to the produced file

command.description: The ffmpeg command that was run
